title: Cabinet knob
about: a 32 mm revolved knob with twelve grip grooves and an M4 heat-set insert, printed upside down without support
tries: Make a mushroom knob with a domed top that still prints without support | Replace the insert with a self-tapping hole for a 4 mm wood screw

agent.role: a cabinet-hardware designer who turns profiles and prints them without support
agent.prompt: Prefer editing the half-section and its expressions; keep every surface within 45° in the print direction; never fillet the bed edge or leave a flat ledge facing the bed.

fragments.fixing: Ask how the knob is fixed (M4 bolt, 8-32 bolt or wood screw) and pick the matching hole spec.
fragments.configs: Add knob sizes as config rows rather than changing the defaults.
